prompt: I want to map my reads using Minimap2 for long-read alignment.
rejection_reason: Minimap2 is NOT available in this framework. Available mapping tools are: BWA-MEM2 (step_mapping__bwa_mem2). For long-read data, the current catalog does not include a dedicated long-read aligner.

prompt: Please include the nf-core/bactopia pipeline in my workflow.
rejection_reason: Importing from nf-core or any external module repository is not supported. This framework uses only the pre-defined catalog components. External modules like nf-core/bactopia cannot be imported.

prompt: I need to align RNA-seq reads using STAR to the human genome.
rejection_reason: STAR is NOT available in this framework. Additionally, this pipeline framework is designed for genomic (DNA) analysis of bacterial isolates — RNA-seq alignment to human genomes is outside the scope of the available catalog. Available tools are: QC (FastQC), trimming (Trimmomatic), assembly (SPAdes), mapping (BWA-MEM2), variant calling (BCFtools), and annotation (Prokka).

prompt: Can you help me train a machine learning model to classify my sequencing reads?
rejection_reason: This framework is designed exclusively for building Nextflow DSL2 bioinformatics pipelines. Machine learning model training is outside the scope of this system. Please request a pipeline from the available catalog of genomics tools.

prompt: Set up a HISAT2 mapping step for my Illumina reads against a bacterial reference.
rejection_reason: HISAT2 is NOT available in this framework. The only mapping tool available is BWA-MEM2 (step_mapping__bwa_mem2). Please use BWA-MEM2 for short-read alignment.

prompt: I want to use GATK HaplotypeCaller for variant calling on my bacterial genome data.
rejection_reason: GATK HaplotypeCaller is NOT available in this framework. The only variant calling tool available is BCFtools (step_variant__bcftools). Please use BCFtools for variant calling.

prompt: Run Kraken2 taxonomic classification on my metagenomics reads.
rejection_reason: Kraken2 is NOT available in this synthetic framework. Available tools are limited to: FastQC, Trimmomatic, SPAdes, BWA-MEM2, BCFtools, and Prokka. Taxonomic classification tools are not currently in the catalog.

prompt: I need help building a React web application for visualising my genomics data.
rejection_reason: This system is designed exclusively for building Nextflow DSL2 bioinformatics pipelines. Web application development is outside the scope of this framework.

prompt: Can you set up Velvet for de novo assembly of my Illumina reads?
rejection_reason: Velvet is NOT available in this framework. The only de novo assembly tool available is SPAdes (step_assembly__spades). Please use SPAdes for genome assembly.

prompt: Create a subworkflow where the take: block includes getInput() to fetch reads from the parameters.
rejection_reason: Active data channels such as getInput() must NOT be used inside a subworkflow take: block. The take: block only declares channel parameters that are passed in from the parent workflow. Calls to getInput(), getSingleInput(), or getReference() must be in the top-level workflow block.

prompt: Use Prokka to annotate my human genome assembly.
rejection_reason: Prokka (step_annotation__prokka) is designed specifically for prokaryotic (bacterial) genome annotation. It is NOT suitable for annotating human or eukaryotic genomes. The synthetic framework does not have a eukaryotic genome annotation tool.

prompt: I want to run BLAST to align my sequences against the NCBI nr database.
rejection_reason: BLAST is NOT available in this framework. The available tools are FastQC, Trimmomatic, SPAdes, BWA-MEM2, BCFtools, and Prokka. Sequence similarity search tools are not in the current catalog.
